actualPrivilegeBoundary.missingAction: Controller-only COMM action now has pinned executor and fixed bootstrap using existing sudo -n. COP configuration change remains unavailable and is not part of this action.

executor.sourceBaselines: Exact current CID/image/runtime digest/input hashes/peer IDs in executor; fresh COP source/image/generation before and after bootstrap. Not a cross-host atomic transaction.
executor.originalEvidence: Exclusive Root journal before first provider write; fsync file and directory; preserve original protected pin. Full runtime/resolved render contain credentials and are never journaled, only their digests.
executor.failure: No automatic retry/adoption or rollback; retain partial controller/config journal; admission remains false.
executor.testsScope: 28 deterministic boundary/protocol tests: process/config/parity/retry, duplicate creation no PUT, registration HMAC/inhibit_login, pending-deactivation timeout no reactivation, wrong whoami/failed logout no custody publication, secret-free probe result, bootstrap hash/generation/modes. Final32 also cover successful login with unexpected device must logout, error status must not logout arbitrary response token, whoami exception cleanup, exact frozen-clock+60000ms request and provider exception cannot publish custody.
executor.dynamicCustody: Explicit <=60s device-less impersonation, exact whoami, logout in finally and subsequent zero-token/device/crypto/pending readback BEFORE custodyReviewed publication; capability with admissionOFF is not claimed to perform it.
executor.deactivationLifecycle: Deployed _user_parter_loop removes users_pending_deactivation only after _part_user completes. Wait for zero while still deactivated, at most10s; only then reactivate. Pending row remains a mandatory zero surface in custody.
